# Test data
Small committed fixtures only (< 1 MB each). Large fixtures are generated by test code.
- `format/`  golden `.pb`, `.folio`, markdown round-trip corpus (`format/markdown/`), per format version (`format/v1/`).
- `device/`  files pushed to the tablet with `scripts/device/push-fixture.sh` (names: A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ - only).
- `pdf/`     small PDFs for import/export tests (generated PDFs are preferred).
- `math/`    LaTeX corpus for the math renderer spike and regression tests.
